description: US-English FCL request to a Chicago forwarder (USD).

input.subject: Need rates: 3x40HC Shenzhen to LA
input.body:
Hey team,

Can I get rates on 3 x 40HC from Shenzhen to Los Angeles, port to port? Camping gear, ready Nov 10. FOB Shenzhen.

Thanks!
Derek
Pinecrest Outdoor Co.

expected.notes: 'ready Nov 10' has no year: the extractor reports only dates the email states in full (no year is guessed), so ready_date is null. Anchoring partial dates on the email's received date is a P4 item (ASSUMPTIONS I8).
